Verdict: REQUEST_CHANGES

1. **[P1] `apps/worker/vitest.config.ts:13` (`wrangler.jsonc:34,110`) — `pnpm check` fails on a clean clone because `packages/db/migrations/control` is an untracked empty directory**
   - **Failure scenario:** `packages/db/migrations/control/` and `packages/db/migrations/tenant/` are empty directories in the worktree, so Git omits them from commits and `/data/tmp/review/TASK-101.diff`. On a clean `git clone`, `packages/db/migrations/control` does not exist; `readD1Migrations(...)` (`@cloudflare/vitest-plugin` `listD1MigrationFiles`, `fs.readdirSync`) throws `ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir '.../packages/db/migrations/control'`, failing `pnpm test:worker` and breaking `Done when: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm check passes on a clean clone`.
   - **Smallest fix:** Commit `.gitkeep` in both `packages/db/migrations/control/.gitkeep` and `packages/db/migrations/tenant/.gitkeep` (`getD1MigrationFiles` filters `*.sql` with `{ dot: false }`, so `.gitkeep` is ignored).

2. **[P1] `apps/web-app/src/styles/theme.css:1–3` (imported by `apps/web-owner/src/index.css:2`) — Omitting `@custom-variant dark` re-enables OS dark-mode styling on comfort primitives, breaking `DEC-222` and `DESIGN.md`**
   - **Failure scenario:** `prototype/src/index.css:7` declared `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));` with no `.dark` class on `<html>` so shadcn's `dark:*` utilities never fired. `theme.css` dropped that directive, causing Tailwind v4 to compile `dark:*` on 10 UI primitives (`button.tsx`, `input.tsx`, `select.tsx`, `switch.tsx`, `tabs.tsx`, `badge.tsx`, `dropdown-menu.tsx`, `avatar.tsx`, `field.tsx`, `toggle.tsx`) under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (present in `dist/assets/app/assets/index-*.css:2`). On any phone or PC in OS dark mode, the page stays `#ffffff` while inputs turn slate-tinted (`dark:bg-input/30`) and switch thumbs turn dark ink (`dark:data-unchecked:bg-foreground`), reproducing the exact defect `DEC-222` forbids.
   - **Smallest fix:** Add `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *));` to `apps/web-app/src/styles/theme.css` immediately after `@import "shadcn/tailwind.css";`.

3. **[P2] `apps/web-app/src/app.tsx:1–11`, `apps/web-owner/src/app.tsx:1–11` — Missing `src/router.tsx` / `RouterProvider` scaffolding violates `TASK-101` contract and blocks downstream `Allowed Paths`**
   - **Failure scenario:** `TASKS.md:88–89` contracts `TASK-101` for `Vite + React 19 + router + shadcn init` in both `apps/web-app/**` and `apps/web-owner/**`, and `TASKS.md:41` designates `apps/*/src/router.*` as the shared router entry. Neither app creates `src/router.tsx` or mounts `RouterProvider` / `QueryClientProvider` (leaving `@tanstack/react-router` and `@tanstack/react-query` unused). Downstream `TASK-105` (`TASKS.md:146–147`) and `TASK-106` (`TASKS.md:162`) only own `src/routes/...` (plus shared `src/router.*`) and cannot edit `src/app.tsx` or `src/main.tsx` without failing `delivery-ledger check-boundary`.
   - **Smallest fix:** Create `apps/web-app/src/router.tsx` and `apps/web-owner/src/router.tsx` (`createRootRoute` + `/` index route rendering the Direction A shell frame) and mount `<QueryClientProvider>` + `<RouterProvider>` in each `src/app.tsx`.

4. **[P2] `apps/web-owner/vite.config.ts:9`, `apps/web-owner/tsconfig.json:7` — `web-owner` aliases `@` to `../web-app/src` instead of its own `src/` (and lacks `components.json`)**
   - **Failure scenario:** Because `@` in `web-owner` resolves to `apps/web-app/src`, any `@/routes/*`, `@/shell/*`, or `@/lib/*` import written inside `apps/web-owner/src/` silently resolves into the tenant/cashier workspace (`apps/web-app/src/`), risking cross-SPA code contamination and breaking standard `@/` imports in `TASK-106` / `TASK-203`. `apps/web-owner/components.json` is also missing (`TASKS.md:89`: `apps/web-owner/** (same)`).
   - **Smallest fix:** Map only the shared UI paths (`@/components/ui`, `@/hooks/use-mobile`, `@/lib/utils`) to `../web-app/src/...` while keeping `@` / `@/*` pointed at `apps/web-owner/src`, or convert the 11 `@/` imports in `apps/web-app/src/components/ui/{field,sheet,sidebar,toggle-group}.tsx` to relative imports so `web-owner` aliases `@` solely to `./src`; add `apps/web-owner/components.json`.

5. **[P2] `apps/worker/src/assets/spa.ts:25–38`, `package.json:17`, `apps/worker/test/` — `serveSpa` `.map`/extension bugs and zero automated Worker tests for host-isolated `ASSETS` serving**
   - **Failure scenario:**
     1. `path.endsWith(".map")` (`spa.ts:27`) runs before `decodeURIComponent` and is case-sensitive while `looksLikeFile` (`spa.ts:28`, `/\.[a-z0-9]{1,8}$/i`) is case-insensitive, letting `.MAP` (on case-insensitive dev filesystems) or percent-encoded `.map` bypass the guard (`DEC-210`).
     2. `/\.[a-z0-9]{1,8}$/i` rejects `.webmanifest` (`11` chars, breaking PWA manifest delivery per `ADR-0001`), returns `404` instead of the SPA shell on deep links containing dotted parameters (e.g. custom-domain routes like `/gerai/kirim.tokobudi.id`), and caches `/index.html` with `public, max-age=300` instead of `no-cache`.
     3. `apps/worker/test/` tests only `/healthz`; no automated test verifies `Done when` (*"both SPAs build and serve their shells via `ASSETS`"* and cross-host `/app/*` vs `/owner/*` isolation), and `package.json:17` runs `pnpm build` *after* `pnpm test:worker` so `dist/assets` is absent during worker tests on a clean clone.
   - **Smallest fix:** Decode `url.pathname` safely (`404` on invalid URI), block `decoded.toLowerCase().endsWith(".map") || decoded.includes("..") || decoded.includes("\\")`, serve `index.html` (`no-cache`) for `/` and `/index.html`, restrict file lookups to `/assets/*` plus an explicit static extension regex including `webmanifest`, run `pnpm build` before `pnpm test:worker` in `package.json` `"check"`, and add `apps/worker/test/spa.test.ts` covering both shells, cross-host bundle `404`, non-SPA host `404`, and `.map` `404`.

6. **[P2] `wrangler.jsonc:54–67,77–84,102–104,129–139`, `.dev.vars.example:5–13`, `apps/worker/src/index.ts:9–18` — `secrets.required` drops `.dev.vars` bindings from `spec 07 §3.2`, and missing `queue()` / `scheduled()` stubs block M1 staging deploy**
   - **Failure scenario:**
     1. In Wrangler `4.162.0` (`getVarsForDev`), defining `"secrets"` switches `.dev.vars` loading to an allowlist of `vars ∪ secrets.required`, silently dropping `MENGANTAR_PARTNER_ID`, `MENGANTAR_PARTNER_SECRET`, `PARTNER_RELAY_URL`, `PARTNER_RELAY_SECRET`, and `CF_SAAS_API_TOKEN` from `env` in `wrangler dev` and omitting them from `wrangler types` `Env`.
     2. `wrangler.jsonc` declares 4 `queues.consumers` and 3 `triggers.crons`, but `apps/worker/src/index.ts` exports only `fetch`. When `TASK-109` deploys `env.staging` in M1 (where `apps/worker/src/index.ts` is outside `TASK-109`'s `Allowed Paths`), Cloudflare rejects queue consumer attachment (`code 10086`) and logs unhandled `scheduled()` runtime errors every 5 minutes.
   - **Smallest fix:** Move `MENGANTAR_PARTNER_ID: "ongkirich"` into `vars` (top-level and `env.staging`), either include all `spec 07 §3.2` secret names in `secrets.required` or remove `"secrets"` until deploy tasks own them (typing optional secrets in `apps/worker/src/env.d.ts`), and add no-op `async queue(_batch) {}, async scheduled(_controller) {}` handlers to `apps/worker/src/index.ts`.

7. **[P2] `scripts/ci/bundle-audit-lib.mjs:7–29,48–54` — Bundle audit misses `spec 05 §4` gate 2 (`SECRET`/`PARTNER`/`PRIVATE` tokens), CSS `/*# sourceMappingURL=` comments, and Mengantar URL-path keys**
   - **Failure scenario:** `docs/spec/05-IAM-SECURITY-AND-PRIVACY.md:57` requires static bundle scanning to fail closed on `SECRET`, `PARTNER`, `PRIVATE`, or key-shaped literals, and `DEC-210` / `AGENTS.md §3.5` targets Mengantar URL-path seller keys. Currently `CLIENT_FORBIDDEN_NAMES` checks only 8 hardcoded names (missing `MENGANTAR_PARTNER_ID`, `MENGANTAR_PARTNER_ORIGIN`, `PARTNER_RELAY_URL`, `WEBHOOK_SECRET`, `TOTP_SECRET`, etc.), `SECRET_PATTERNS` lacks a Mengantar `/api/public/<key>` literal check, and `/\/\/[#@] sourceMappingURL=/` misses CSS `/*# sourceMappingURL=... */` comments.
   - **Smallest fix:** Extend `scanText` to match `/(\/\/|\/\*)[#@]\s*sourceMappingURL=/`, scan client bundles (`client: true`) for `/\b[A-Z0-9_]*(?:SECRET|PARTNER|PRIVATE)[A-Z0-9_]*\b/` (verified 0 false positives on current `dist/assets`), and add `https?://(?:sandbox-)?api-public\.mengantar\.com/api/public/(?!\{)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}` to `SECRET_PATTERNS` with unit tests in `scripts/ci/bundle-audit.test.mjs`.

8. **[P2] `apps/web-app/src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx:197–198,273,285,288`, `apps/web-app/src/components/ui/sheet.tsx:75`, `apps/web-app/src/components/ui/breadcrumb.tsx:10,111` — Residual English UI strings in copied shadcn primitives**
   - **Failure scenario:** `sidebar.tsx:288` renders a visible English tooltip `title="Toggle Sidebar"` alongside English `aria-label` / `sr-only` copy (`"Sidebar"`, `"Displays the mobile sidebar."`, `"Toggle Sidebar"`, `"Close"`, `"More"`), violating `TASK-101` (`Indonesian UI strings, English code`), `AGENTS.md §2`, and `DESIGN.md`. `TASK-203` consumes these primitives for Super Admin but its `Allowed Paths` excludes `apps/web-app/src/components/ui/**`.
   - **Smallest fix:** Translate those labels to Bahasa Indonesia (`"Navigasi samping"`, `"Menampilkan navigasi samping."`, `"Buka atau tutup navigasi"`, `"Tutup"`, `"Navigasi halaman"`, `"Lainnya"`).

9. **[P3] `.gitignore:4` — `.dev.vars` pattern does not ignore `.dev.vars.<env>` files**
   - **Failure scenario:** Wrangler loads `.dev.vars.staging` when running `wrangler dev --env staging`; `.gitignore` only ignores exact `.dev.vars` and `*.local`, risking accidental staging secret commits.
   - **Smallest fix:** Replace `.dev.vars` with `.dev.vars*` and `!.dev.vars.example` in `.gitignore`.
